context_needed: Maldonado et al. (2019), Documentos CEDE: Sembrando Oportunidades Familia por Familia (SOF), a graduation pilot in Paraguay. The RCT assignment was not followed in full, so the impact evaluation is IV: the original randomisation variable instruments receipt of the programme, giving a local average treatment effect (PDF pages 13-14). The first stage (probability of receiving SOF given assignment) is described but never printed as a table; the text gives only participation of 70% when assigned to treatment against 40% in control (PDF page 13). The IV compares all treated groups (full SOF, extended pilot, PRODERS) with pure controls, 1,005 endline households, endline October 2017. 'Effect SD of CG' scales the IV effect by the control group's standard deviation. 'RE' (results evaluation) is a baseline-to-endline change for treated households only, which the authors call non-experimental (PDF page 14). Outcomes are shares of households (poverty headcounts).

rule: An IV / 2SLS effect of receiving the programme is stored as the effect, with the estimand (LATE or TOT) named in arm. Its standardised version ('Effect SD of CG') is a second row with effect_type 'standardised effect size'. A first stage is stored only if printed, with effect_type 'first stage'. Read decimal commas as decimal points.

resolved_questions.question: (1) The RE columns are a pre-post change among treated households only. The rules settle DiD versus a follow-up difference, but not a single-group before-after change printed beside the IV effect. They are left unstored here; confirm. (2) The IV 'treated' group pools three different interventions (full SOF, extended pilot, PRODERS), so the arm label says 'SOF programme' only loosely (the authors note the effect may be underestimated for that reason, PDF page 13). (3) As printed, 'Poverty by PPI' has an RE change of 0,04 but a scaled change of -0,08 (opposite signs); unstored, but worth knowing if RE is ever stored.
resolved_questions.resolution: Decided by Lucas, 22 Nov 2026: a treated-only before-after change is never stored.
